question.text: Name the EM wave used for studying crystal structure of solids

solution.text: X – Rays radiation is a form of electromagnetic radiation. X-rays have a wavelength in the range of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>0</mn><mo>.</mo><mn>01</mn><mo> </mo><mi>nm</mi></math> to <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>10</mn><mo> </mo><mi>nm</mi></math>, corresponding to frequencies in the range <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>30</mn><mo> </mo><mi>PHz</mi></math> to <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>30</mn><mo> </mo><mi>EHz</mi></math>. Therefore, they are used in studying crystals structure of solids.
